critique_history.assessment:
- The outlet nozzle/aerator visibly floats below the gooseneck; extend the neck and overlap the connected nozzle.
- The bowl reads nearly flat in several views; deepen and steepen the interior so the carved basin is obvious.
- Marble veining is overly repetitive and covers every surface uniformly; use broader organic variation with restrained pale veins.
- The faucet handle assembly looks fragmented; simplify it into a clearly attached single lever.
The model clearly presents a complete square dark-green marble sink with a deep glossy basin and an attached chrome gooseneck faucet and single lever.
